source_note: Astro 7 blog reports 15-61% faster builds vs v6 (astro.build/blog/astro-7/). Our v5 median was 24612ms, v7 median 17832ms. Astro 6 was an incremental step between v5 and v7 — v6 introduced the experimental Rust compiler but kept the JS markdown pipeline. Estimated v6 build time assumes ~10% improvement over v5 (new dev server, no major build pipeline changes until v7's Rust compiler + Sätteri).

builds.note: Estimated ~10% faster than v5 (24612ms). Astro 7 blog shows v7 is 15-61% faster than v6 on large sites.

output.note: Bundle sizes not measured — no v6 commit exists in this repo's history

dependencies.note: Not measured — no v6 install available
